collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two children count the waves to find out which one is the biggest.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two children count the waves to find out which one is the biggest. They agree it is the seventh, though neither can say why.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two children count the waves to find out which one is the biggest. A big wave soaks them both mid-count.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two children count the waves to find out which one is the biggest. They lose count and start over several times.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two children count the waves to find out which one is the biggest. An elder joins them and admits to having done the same thing as a child.
